candidate_verification: Focused release SQL-driven bitwise cost test and release build passed. Full candidate gates and regression were not run after performance rejection.
measurement_limits: Warm 200,000-row read workload, five alternating ten-second measured pairs plus warmup. Small observed negative range signal; point ranges overlap. No general zero-benefit, estimator CPU attribution, memory advantage, or production-mode claim.
export_policy: Executable bytes, fixture directories and temporary build files are retained locally and omitted. Captured absolute paths preserve historical cache provenance; evidence paths in this manifest are export-relative.
audit_limits: verify.py regenerates the fixture expectation and recomputes summaries from raw client/resource records. Build exits, original fixture-file equality, binary hashes, source equality and cleanup are recorded evidence, not independently rerun by the portable audit. Omitted executable bytes cannot be rehashed from this export.
build_control_limit: Candidate selected --bin roll-engine only; baseline also selected --example bench --example scan_bench. Different Cargo dependency fingerprints were confirmed by rebuilding reverted source with the candidate command. The comparison does not isolate source changes; rejection records failure to establish the required gain, not a source-only negative effect.
